phase1_initial_proposals.technology_specification: Permanent magnet synchronous electric motor (PMSM) designed specifically for traction use in battery electric vehicles (BEVs). These motors serve as the primary propulsion source, converting electrical energy from the battery into mechanical torque to drive the vehicle's wheels.
phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: Permanent magnet synchronous motors dominate the electric vehicle propulsion market due to their high power density, efficiency (above 90%), and compact size. They are the prevailing motor type used globally in BEVs as of 2024, favored over induction or switched reluctance motors in passenger vehicles for their performance benefits.
